# Release notes, draft

Collected over the week. Sections are separated generously so that each one
can be copied on its own into the changelog.


















## Fixed

- The settings page no longer loses the theme on reload.
- An export with an empty filter produced an empty file; it now says so.















## Added

- A keyboard shortcut for the search box.
- The audit log can be filtered by user.










## Known

- The mobile layout of the billing page wraps the totals. Tracked separately.
